world_fit_review.pattern_specific_checks: Native RGBA and native light/dark composites inspected. Clearly an upright speaking cast character with a large round head, short compact torso, two relaxed arm-hands, two standing feet, cream-white oval eyes and gentle humanlike smile, matching Siamese cat/hedgehog/tora rather than natural quadruped stance. Main coat dark charcoal grey with rusty ears and lower extremities, pale lower jaw and small throat patch, one thick dark-tipped tail; deliberately not a bright red-orange or white-tailed red fox. Short muzzle and limbs maintain small Darwin fox impression while mascot proportions are explicit. No duplicate anatomy, clipped extremities, floating foreign objects or visible halo. Both soles support the pose and all edges remain clean on light/dark. Simplified picture-book coat does not claim photoreal taxonomic diagnosis.
world_fit_review.basis: Actual selected native source and light/dark composites assessed after the user specified two patterns; prior natural-pose technical QA is not reused as current adoption permission.

geometry.anchor_measurement: manually observed anatomical support/centre in the native full-body image; not alpha-canvas centering
geometry.anchor_basis: Large rounded head through compact upright trunk and two foot soles, excluding ear tips and lateral single tail; midpoint of both planted soles is grounded support.
geometry.vertical_motion_policy: neutral still; scene placement and any trajectory are designed by consumer, no motion acceptance claimed

resolution_review.review_basis: Native light/dark composites visually inspected; species/face/contour remain readable. This is a static asset display limit, not a completed-video acceptance.

alpha_policy: Original RGBA bytes retained, alpha254 and imperceptible <8 isolated fringes are not erased; visible light/dark composites govern image-quality decision.
scope: One independent neutral original inspected at native resolution and on light/dark backgrounds. No poses, interpolation, runtime or completed-video acceptance claimed.
